purpose: Repeat saved deterministic-checkpoint TensorRT engine timing without rebuilding
timing_scope: RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, fixed batch 1 zero input, FP16-enabled TensorRT, default CUDA stream, synchronized wall-clock model-only, excluding preprocessing and transfers.
limitations: Two nonrandomized replay passes and one engine build per model; uncontrolled thermal and power state; default stream can add synchronization; not Orin.
